description: The fast, catalog/read-tier pass over a Postgres database — schema inventory (schema_inventory), row counts (row_count_snapshot), credential visibility (credential_capability), and the operations bundle's scouting-tier half (db_activity_signals, db_resilience). postgres_operations also backs an analysis-tier analysis (db_external_dependencies) and an assessment-tier one (privilege_audit) that this step cannot be split apart from — it is chained into all three Survey Definitions (Scouting, Analysis, Assessment) as a result, each under its own qualified name, so each document's ScopedBy links only claim the questions its own analyses answer.
